inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL migration populates a target table from joined source rows with LEFT JOIN and COALESCE fallbacks, then uses ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE to refresh existing target keys in place.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a catalog assignment refresh. Active catalog items join account assignments and optional item overrides; COALESCE supplies a default note, and INSERT ... SELECT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE refreshes existing assignment rows while inserting a new assignment. The source schema, identifiers, values, and article-migration data are not copied.

fixture_notes: Assignment 901 is refreshed from a newer catalog title and keeps the default note because no override exists. Assignment 902 receives its override note. Assignment 903 is inserted from the same SELECT source; inactive item 804 is excluded.
determinism_notes: Catalog, assignment, override, active-state, and final ordering data are fixed; each active item maps to one assignment and at most one override; there are no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules.
setup: CREATE TABLE catalog_items (item_id INT PRIMARY KEY, item_title VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, item_state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE account_assignments (assignment_id INT PRIMARY KEY, account_id INT NOT NULL, item_id INT NOT NULL, assigned_note VARCHAR(64) NULL, UNIQUE KEY account_item (account_id, item_id))
CREATE TABLE item_overrides (override_id INT PRIMARY KEY, account_id INT NOT NULL, item_id INT NOT NULL, override_note VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, UNIQUE KEY account_item_override (account_id, item_id))
INSERT INTO catalog_items VALUES (801, 'Atlas Kit', 'active'), (802, 'Beacon Kit', 'active'), (803, 'Cedar Kit', 'active'), (804, 'Dormant Kit', 'inactive')
INSERT INTO account_assignments VALUES (901, 41, 801, NULL), (902, 41, 802, 'old note')

steps.sql: INSERT INTO account_assignments (assignment_id, account_id, item_id, assigned_note) SELECT CASE c.item_id WHEN 801 THEN 901 WHEN 802 THEN 902 WHEN 803 THEN 903 END, 41, c.item_id, COALESCE(o.override_note, 'catalog default') FROM catalog_items AS c LEFT JOIN item_overrides AS o ON o.account_id = 41 AND o.item_id = c.item_id WHERE c.item_state = 'active' ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE item_id = VALUES(item_id), assigned_note = VALUES(assigned_note)
SELECT assignment_id, account_id, item_id, assigned_note FROM account_assignments ORDER BY assignment_id

checks.sql: SELECT assignment_id, account_id, item_id, assigned_note FROM account_assignments ORDER BY assignment_id
